# Thurlstone Timber - September weighbridge

One row for each consignment that crossed the weighbridge. The tonnes column is the
net weight, taken after the empty lorry has been weighed off.

turns.prompt: Thurlstone Timber has to name the heaviest consignment in the September sawmill return. How many tonnes did that consignment weigh? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
